UN list of countries and territories by population

This is a list of countries and other inhabited territories of the world by estimated total population. It is based on estimates published by the United Nations in the 2024 revision of World Population Prospects. It presents population estimates from 1950 to the present.[2]

List

[edit]

Data are mid-year estimates from the United Nations and are for 2022 and 2023.[2]
